summary: Self Host Blocks is a modular server management tool built on NixOS modules. It provides a structured approach to configuring infrastructure with an emphasis on established operational best practices.
goodFor: This is a solid option for administrators already using NixOS who want structured, reusable configurations for their self-hosted services.
watchOut: The AGPL-3.0 licence requires source code disclosure if you modify and network-host the software, and adoption is limited compared to mainstream control panels.
deployNotes: Deployment typically requires a host running NixOS with persistent storage allocated for your managed services and a separate reverse proxy configured for TLS termination.
